text: Conflicting numbers: the VAT threshold appears as 75 000 € (original minfin draft), 60 000 € (Mediapool's 23 Oct correction) and the current threshold as both 51 130 € and 51 300 € depending on outlet; the МРЗ is quoted as a fixed €660 by МТСП while the same minister left room above it on 26 Oct.
